name: Monir Ahammod (모니르 아하마드)
biography: “Imagination is more important than knowledge.” – Albert Einstein. Driven by curiosity and inspired by this quote, I explore connections across ideas and disciplines. My journey spans roles as a mentor, researcher, and full-time Lecturer of Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Uttara University in Bangladesh. Then, I’m obtained my MSc in Artificial Intelligence at Chonnam National University, South Korea in 2025, under supervision of Kwanghoon Choi, focusing on LLMs and code completion. My research interests lie in Large Language Model, AI in healthcare, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and AI for real-world impact. I'm now seeking a Ph.D. opportunity where I can contribute to solving global challenges with innovative solutions.
researchIntro: I am highly interested in research fields.
researchInterests: Large Language Model (ChatGPT, Llama), Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning
coCurricularIntro: Out of my academic life, I try to take on roles in various on and off campus activities. I have taken on leadership and volunteering roles and received awards and scholarships in recognition of my academic achievements. I am an avid fan of sports and humanitarian activities.
